decisions.decision: For multi-day posts spanning 2 real calendar days, use the arrival/first day as the post's single `date` field (established pattern from Peterborough, Bobcaygeon/Fenelon Falls fixes)
decisions.rationale: Consistent with how these posts' own narrative content is structured (one post covering an arrival + a stay or a 2-leg push)

decisions.decision: When a post's own frontmatter miles/hours differs from a same-dated Nebo trip-log entry's distanceNm/underwayHours, don't blindly overwrite -- they can be two independently legitimate measurements (full daily GPX slice vs. Nebo's own start/stop voyage timer). Only trust the log's number when there's no other source or when cross-validated.
decisions.rationale: Discovered on 'going to anchor first time' (2022-05-25): existing miles=34.3 (GPX-based) vs. Nebo log's 27.7 (voyage-timer-based) are both real, just measuring slightly different things

decisions.decision: Never re-run scripts/00-index-photos.mjs scoped to a narrow date range against the live .planning/data/photo-index.json -- it overwrites the whole shared file. Query the Photos.sqlite database directly with a standalone scoped script instead when only a few dates are needed.
decisions.rationale: Did this by mistake this session, caught immediately via git status and restored from git before anything else touched it. No lasting damage, but a real near-miss.

context_notes: Extremely long single-session continuation (picked up mid-session via /gsd-resume-work, kept going for many hours) -- 16 commits, all pushed to origin/main, working tree clean. Grew entirely from the user browsing the live site (localhost:4322, dev server running in PREVIEW_DRAFTS=1 mode, pid still alive) and pointing out issues one at a time -- a missing A-to-B turned into finding and fixing a second whole date-cascade bug, then a site-wide OCR bug audit across all 171 Nebo trip-log entries, then more title/location corrections from the user's own trip memory, then discovering and filling a genuine 2-day content gap. Two real near-misses this session were caught and corrected before any damage: a duplicate YAML key from an edit that didn't check the full file first (caught by the build breaking), and the photo-index.json overwrite described above. All findings not yet fixed are logged in project memory under .claude/projects/.../memory/ -- read project_days65_72_chronology_cluster.md and project_nebo_logs_ocr_bug.md before continuing, they have full detail and the exact verification method that's worked repeatedly this session (read the real Nebo map screenshot image directly with the Read tool, cross-check against the post's own narrative text and against distance/underwayHours = avg speed, don't trust any single stored number in isolation).
